section_6_evidence_handoff.finding: propositions.marshal_and_verify's schema is structurally single-span: evidence_anchor_chunk_id, evidence_span_id, and quote are all singular fields on a persisted proposition record. This PREDATES Section 5's work -- it already held for grow_context's own +/-2 packets -- and is not something the new +/-3 neighborhood introduces, though recovery specifically targets cases needing wider context, making the limitation more likely to actually matter there.
what_does_work: recovered multi-chunk context DOES reach proposition formation: qwen.form_claim's context_text is built from every chunk in the packet, not just the one selected span's chunk
a claim CAN synthesize facts across chunks (the model sees the full context)
source coordinates ARE accurate for whatever IS persisted -- verification (canonical_text_contains) always re-checks the actual single anchor chunk's real text
what_does_not_work: a claim that synthesizes facts from chunk N and chunk N+1 can only ever persist ONE of those chunks as its evidence_anchor_chunk_id/quote -- the other chunk's contribution has no persisted anchor of its own
provenance.context_read (a list of all chunk_ids read) is diagnostic-only and is never used for verification
section_6_evidence_handoff.regression_test: test_rounds_mechanics.py::MultiChunkEvidenceCollapsesToASingleAnchorTests::test_a_three_chunk_packet_gives_form_claim_full_context_but_persists_only_one_chunks_span -- a real 3-chunk packet whose claim asserts two separately-sourced numeric facts; proves the model saw both, the claim states both, but only one chunk's quote is persisted and only that one chunk is what verification actually checks.
section_6_evidence_handoff.connection_to_wider_project: app's own H1b spec (.claude/docs/specs/2026-09-05-evidence-unit-contract.md) already states as a load-bearing rule that canonical_text_contains must never be relaxed to accept an assembled multi-span string -- so leaving this single-span and reporting it, rather than silently redesigning it, is consistent with an existing project-wide invariant, not merely cautious.

smallest_viable_alternatives.consequence: a recovery-widened claim that genuinely needs two chunks keeps exactly today's guarantee -- its one persisted quote is always verbatim-verified against its one real chunk -- but a reader inspecting only the evidence_anchor_chunk_id will not see the second chunk's contribution to the claim, even though provenance.context_read names it.

smallest_viable_alternatives.option: B: add a plural evidence-anchor list (evidence_anchor_chunk_ids/evidence_span_ids/quotes, each independently verified) alongside the existing singular fields
smallest_viable_alternatives.consequence: a real schema/scientific-contract change: the coordinate-honesty contract (Callosum invariant #2: exact/region/null) would need a defined meaning for MULTIPLE simultaneous exact locations on one claim; the renderer, the verifier's per-span confidence semantics, and every downstream consumer of evidence_anchor_chunk_id (singular) would need updating or an explicit migration; NLI/support-confidence would need a defined combination rule across spans rather than one score per claim.

smallest_viable_alternatives.option: C: split a genuinely multi-chunk-dependent claim into two separately-verified propositions at claim-formation time
smallest_viable_alternatives.consequence: avoids a schema change, but changes qwen.form_claim's own task (one span -> one claim would become an explicit multi-claim decomposition step) and could fragment a claim a reader would expect to read as one sentence; unclear whether the two propositions' relationship (that they jointly support one comparison) would itself need a new field to record.

The only Qwen3.5:9B-thinking-OFF binding that exists is the W (worker/discovery) role's own per-evidence-item claim-formation calls (qwen.form_claim etc, inside _process_hits) -- a per-evidence-item mechanism, not a per-child answer-synthesis step.
